descriptionChirho: To dig or excavate the ground, a pit, or a well (Qal active, all inflections).
Passive of digging: to be dug or excavated (Nifal stem).
To bargain, negotiate, or trade, a secondary meaning of the root used in commercial contexts.
To open or pierce, as in digging open the ears; a figurative extension of the root (cf. Psalm 40:7).
